purpose: Address reviewer questions without modifying canonical v1 or v2 artifacts.

compute.expert_training: reuse the exact v2 Spanish PASS_READINESS adapters; no retraining

plumbing_gate.purpose: Distinguish adapter correctness from a large-perturbation linearisation failure.

zero_donor.expected: all injections, predictions, and measured changes are zero up to floating-point tolerance

fake_donor.grafts: representative early/middle/late singletons, adjacent pairs, and deterministic seeded sets of size 4
fake_donor.interpretation: A failed large-scale score is an applicability stop, not an implementation failure.

real_donor.grafts: same singleton/pair probe set as fake donor
real_donor.purpose: Report the real Qwen3 local linearisation diagnostic without authorizing E1.

stop_rules: STOP_SETUP if the exact pinned preflight or adapter pin fails.
STOP_P1_ZERO if the zero-donor invariant fails.
STOP_P1_FAKE if all small fake-donor scales fail the singleton gate.
P1_PASS_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY does not authorize a ranking sweep; a separate contract is required.
